intro: The Purobot Ultra packs and seals waste on its own and identifies cats by face, which gives it two systems most boxes lack and two extra things that can need attention. Both are covered below; everything else is on the common troubleshooting page.

facts.text: When the 10 L bin is full it seals the bag and loads a fresh one automatically.
PETKIT rates the included bag supply at roughly 200 days for one cat.
Odour control uses the N60 odour eliminator, a consumable sold in packs.
Connects over 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz Wi-Fi.

symptoms.title: A full bag is not sealed or replaced
symptoms.summary: The bin reaches capacity but the bag is left open, or no new bag is loaded.
causes: The bag supply has run out.
The bag supply was not loaded the way the manual shows.

fixes.detail: Confirm bags remain. The bundled supply is rated at about 200 days for one cat and runs out sooner with more.
Remove and reload the bags following the diagram in the PETKIT manual exactly.

symptoms.escalate: If packing still fails with a correctly loaded genuine supply, the packing mechanism needs PETKIT support.

symptoms.title: Face recognition muddles the cats
symptoms.summary: Visit records land on the wrong cat even though each has a profile.
causes: The camera cannot see faces clearly in poor light.

fixes.detail: Facial recognition needs a usable view; add a low light near the unit for night-time visits.
Wipe it with a soft dry cloth regularly — litter dust settles on it fast.

symptoms.escalate: Persistent misidentification in good light is a software matter for PETKIT.

symptoms.title: Odour returns after a few weeks
symptoms.summary: The unit was odour-free at first, but smell creeps back over time.
causes: The N60 odour eliminator is a consumable and has been used up.

fixes.detail: Fit a fresh N60 odour eliminator and keep a spare on hand.

symptoms.escalate: If smell persists with a new N60 and a clean bin, work through the common odour steps.
